Introduction

X-UNIT is the first official subunit of the South Korean boy group XODIAC, formed under One Cool Jacso Entertainment. The unit consists of members Lex, Hyunsik, Sing, and Leo. X-UNIT made their debut with their 1st mini album titled TO U, showcasing a more refined and unique musical identity within the XODIAC universe.
